shape.text: The dump happens before the settings change
shape.evidence: "1. Back up SQLite and dump the data, before touching any settings:"; states the ordering directly, and dumps in step 1, before the settings change in step 4.
"python manage.py migrate"; every step (backup+dump, driver, role/db, settings, migrate, load) has an explicit command.
"Verify: run `python manage.py runserver`, open `http://127.0.0.1:8000/admin/`, and confirm your existing objects are listed there."; final line is the verification step.
